bugs_found: transfer is not atomic: debit is applied before credit, so if credit assignment/addition fails the source account remains debited
transfer does not normalize or validate amount as Decimal, allowing wrong types or non-finite Decimal values to cause TypeError or corrupt balances/receipts
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial behavior without error
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment behavior without error
compound_interest does not reject negative principal, allowing nonsensical negative balances to grow
fx_convert does not validate FX rate positivity/finite value, so zero, negative, NaN, or Infinity rates can produce invalid conversions
all money functions omit scale/rounding rules, so returned monetary amounts can have arbitrary precision and silently differ from production ledger expectations
